caseName: BURKARD Et Al. v. NEW YORK
attorneys: Victor Rabinowitz, Leonard B. Boudin and Samuel A. Neuberger for appellants in No. 807. Edward Bennett Williams and Raymond W. Bergan for appellants in No. 808., Frank S. Hogan for appellee in both cases.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeals are dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeals were taken as petitions for writs of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
